Everything inside each is committed together or not at all.</font><div><font style=""><font style="font-size: 14px;">- Isolation level: READ COMMITTED plus explicit row locks (SELECT FOR UPDATE). Every balance change goes through a locked account row, so SERIALIZABLE is not needed and there are no serialization retries.</font></font></div><div><font style=""><font style="font-size: 14px;">- Transactions are append-only (no UPDATE/DELETE, enforced by a trigger); a correction is a new entry, never an edit.</font><span style="font-size: 14px;"><br>- Step 1 order: 1.1 key (duplicate check) -&gt; 1.2 lock account_from -&gt; 1.3 transfer (gives transfer_id) -&gt; 1.4 outbox event -&gt; 1.5 key gets transfer_id and the response.</span><br><span style="font-size: 14px;">- Step 5 order: 5.1 lock the transfer, stop if status is not PENDING -&gt; 5.2 lock both accounts -&gt; 5.3 balances and last_seq -&gt; 5.4 two entries -&gt; 5.5 final status -&gt; 5.6 outbox "processed".</span><br><span style="font-size: 14px;">- Business failure (e.g. insufficient funds): status = FAILED, error_code set, 5.3 and 5.4 are skipped, the result still goes out through the outbox.</span><br><span style="font-size: 14px;">- Kafka offset is committed only after COMMIT of TX_2; a redelivery is absorbed by the status check in 5.1.</span><br><span style="font-size: 14px;">- The client gets the final result by polling GET /transfers/:id.</span></font></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="174" width="1460" x="419" y="2561" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6iVnRWDK4wrVkIAHLiFq-107" value="<b>Enum values</b><br><br><b>account_status</b> (accounts)<br>ACTIVE, FROZEN, DISABLED<br><br><b>transfer_status</b> (transfers)<br>PENDING, SUCCESSFUL, FAILED<br><br><b>transaction_type</b> (transactions)<br>DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL<br><br><b>event_type</b> (outbox)<br>created, processed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="187" width="260" x="1369" y="3221" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6iVnRWDK4wrVkIAHLiFq-153" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=top;arcSize=6;" value="<b>Delivery guarantees</b><br><div>- Relay: send to Kafka, wait for the broker ack, only then&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">UPDATE sent_at</span></div><div>- Crash between the two: the message is sent again (at-least-once)</div><div>- Consumer is idempotent: if the transfer status is not PENDING&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));"><i>(see step 5.1 in Request Path diagram below)</i>, skip it and commit the offset</span></div><div>- Offset is committed only after COMMIT of TX_2&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">(enable.auto.commit=false): a crash after COMMIT means a&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">redelivery, never a lost transfer</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="111" width="460" x="810" y="1649" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6iVnRWDK4wrVkIAHLiFq-154" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=top;arcSize=6;" value="<b>Retries and DLQ</b><br><div>- Temporary error (DB down, timeout): retry the same message&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">every 1 s until it succeeds (FixedBackOff, no attempt limit)</span></div><div>- Later messages of the same account wait, so the order per&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">account is kept</span></div><div>- A stuck message blocks its whole partition: alert on consumer lag</div><div>- Invalid or unreadable message: no retry, straight to DLQ,&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">account is blocked, alarm, manual process</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="111" width="460" x="1630" y="1649" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6iVnRWDK4wrVkIAHLiFq-155" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=top;arcSize=6;" value="<b>Money and history pagination</b><br><div>- Amount is a whole number of minimal currency units:&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">EUR 100.50 = 10050, JPY 100 = 100, KWD 0.100 = 100</span></div><div>- No float, double or MONEY type: amount bigint + currency</div><div>- Money.of uses setScale(UNNECESSARY): 100.555 EUR is&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">rejected, longValueExact catches overflow</span></div><div>- GET transactions: cursor = last seq_id (opaque string)</div><div>&nbsp; WHERE account_id = :id AND seq_id &lt; :cursor</div><div>&nbsp; ORDER BY seq_id DESC LIMIT :limit + 1</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="141.5" width="360" x="1369" y="3431" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6iVnRWDK4wrVkIAHLiFq-156" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=top;arcSize=6;" value="<div><b>Security and audit</b></div><div><div>- API Gateway validates the OAuth2/OIDC access token (signature, expiry, audience) and checks the scope of each endpoint; least privilege per client</div><div>- Object-level authorization in the API, before TX_1 and on every read (accounts, transactions, transfers): the account must belong to the caller (accounts.owner_id = token subject), otherwise 404</div><div>- Input validation: amount &gt; 0, known currency, account_from &lt;&gt; account_to; all SQL is parameterized, so no string concatenation</div><div>- Audit trail: who (client_id, owner_id), what (transfer_id), when; no sensitive data in logs, payloads or error messages</div><div>- TLS between all services, encryption at rest (Aurora, MSK), secrets in AWS Secrets Manager, not in config or code</div></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="173.5" width="474" x="410" y="1337.5" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6iVnRWDK4wrVkIAHLiFq-157" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;spacingLeft=10;fontSize=11;verticalAlign=top;arcSize=6;" value="<div><b>Reconciliation</b></div><div>- Reconciliation job (daily, reads the READER, never the WRITER):</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp;1. account balance = sum of its entries (DEPOSIT +, WITHDRAWAL -)</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp;2. every SUCCESSFUL transfer has exactly 2 entries, FAILED has 0</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp;3. no transfer stays PENDING longer than 5 minutes</div><div>&nbsp; &nbsp;4. no outbox row stays unsent (sent_at IS NULL) longer than 2 minutes</div><div>- Any mismatch raises an alarm and goes to the manual process; the job only reports, it never fixes balances itself</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="591" x="1879" y="1303" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="6iVnRWDK4wrVkIAHLiFq-158" edge="1" parent="1" source="6iVnRWDK4wrVkIAHLiFq-159" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;" div.span:
Notes
- Two atomic DB transactions: step 1 (API) and step 5 (consumer). Everything inside each is committed together or not at all.

span.span: - Isolation level: READ COMMITTED plus explicit row locks (SELECT FOR UPDATE). Every balance change goes through a locked account row, so SERIALIZABLE is not needed and there are no serialization retries.
- Transactions are append-only (no UPDATE/DELETE, enforced by a trigger); a correction is a new entry, never an edit.
- Step 1 order: 1.1 key (duplicate check) -> 1.2 lock account_from -> 1.3 transfer (gives transfer_id) -> 1.4 outbox event -> 1.5 key gets transfer_id and the response.
- Step 5 order: 5.1 lock the transfer, stop if status is not PENDING -> 5.2 lock both accounts -> 5.3 balances and last_seq -> 5.4 two entries -> 5.5 final status -> 5.6 outbox "processed".
- Business failure (e.g. insufficient funds): status = FAILED, error_code set, 5.3 and 5.4 are skipped, the result still goes out through the outbox.
- Kafka offset is committed only after COMMIT of TX_2; a redelivery is absorbed by the status check in 5.1.
- The client gets the final result by polling GET /transfers/:id.

div.div:
Enum values
account_status (accounts)
ACTIVE, FROZEN, DISABLED
transfer_status (transfers)
PENDING, SUCCESSFUL, FAILED
transaction_type (transactions)
DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL
event_type (outbox)
created, processed

div.div: - Relay: send to Kafka, wait for the broker ack, only then UPDATE sent_at
- Crash between the two: the message is sent again (at-least-once)
- Consumer is idempotent: if the transfer status is not PENDING (see step 5.1 in Request Path diagram below), skip it and commit the offset
- Offset is committed only after COMMIT of TX_2 (enable.auto.commit=false): a crash after COMMIT means a redelivery, never a lost transfer

rect.style: fill: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 448px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1662px; margin-left: 1437px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div: - Temporary error (DB down, timeout): retry the same message every 1 s until it succeeds (FixedBackOff, no attempt limit)
- Later messages of the same account wait, so the order per account is kept
- A stuck message blocks its whole partition: alert on consumer lag
- Invalid or unreadable message: no retry, straight to DLQ, account is blocked, alarm, manual process

rect.style: fill: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.div: - Amount is a whole number of minimal currency units: EUR 100.50 = 10050, JPY 100 = 100, KWD 0.100 = 100
- No float, double or MONEY type: amount bigint + currency
- Money.of uses setScale(UNNECESSARY): 100.555 EUR is rejected, longValueExact catches overflow
- GET transactions: cursor = last seq_id (opaque string)

rect.style: fill: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: - API Gateway validates the OAuth2/OIDC access token (signature, expiry, audience) and checks the scope of each endpoint; least privilege per client
- Object-level authorization in the API, before TX_1 and on every read (accounts, transactions, transfers): the account must belong to the caller (accounts.owner_id = token subject), otherwise 404
- Input validation: amount > 0, known currency, account_from <> account_to; all SQL is parameterized, so no string concatenation
- Audit trail: who (client_id, owner_id), what (transfer_id), when; no sensitive data in logs, payloads or error messages
- TLS between all services, encryption at rest (Aurora, MSK), secrets in AWS Secrets Manager, not in config or code

rect.style: fill: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 579px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1316px; margin-left: 1686px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div: - Reconciliation job (daily, reads the READER, never the WRITER):
1. account balance = sum of its entries (DEPOSIT +, WITHDRAWAL -)
2. every SUCCESSFUL transfer has exactly 2 entries, FAILED has 0
3. no transfer stays PENDING longer than 5 minutes
4. no outbox row stays unsent (sent_at IS NULL) longer than 2 minutes
- Any mismatch raises an alarm and goes to the manual process; the job only reports, it never fixes balances itself
